title: WALTEUR Document Quality
description: Class-specific quality proof for the `document` build class (memo, deck, PRD, proposal, policy). Covers the document extra-proof that generic gates miss: structure, source-citation/audit, readability, and a humanizer pass for external docs. Validated by doc-quality-gate.sh.

audience.description: External docs require a humanizer pass (HARNESS-LOOP document extra-proof).

deliverables.description: The actual document files this build produced.

path.description: Project-relative path to the deliverable; must exist.

type.description: memo | deck | prd | proposal | policy | other

has_sections.description: The doc is sectioned, not an unbroken wall of text.

claims_total.description: Load-bearing factual claims in the doc.

claims_cited.description: Claims with a cited source. Gate requires cited == total.

max_paragraph_words.description: Longest paragraph length; gate caps it to flag walls of text.

passed.description: AI-tell humanizer/best pass ran and passed. Required true for external audience.
